_about: Lane-independent rules for `db.py final`. Evaluated top to bottom against a non-PASS row's fail_reason; the first match decides. Rows that match no rule are FILTERED as ambiguous (owner rule 2026-08-21: when in doubt, filter) and listed for review. Never put a lane, job name or build number in a pattern: lanes change. Policy: runbook_release_final_snapshot.md.
